entry.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
entry.summary:
Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters.

entry.title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration. Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve.
entry.summary:
Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents #robotics
